column1: # Role registry for LM Studio (ADR 0016). Tab-separated. One of the two files
# allowed to name concrete models (the other is docs/MODELS.md).
# model_key is the modelKey from `lms ls --json`, with @variant when a model
# has several quantisations on disk. ctx and slots are per load;
# slots > 1 becomes `lms load --parallel`. Read by scripts/lms-load.sh.
